description: The entire Priority REST API — every form, subform, batch, and attachment — plus offline sync, schema intelligence, and throttle-safe bulk operations no other Priority tool has.

novel_features.name: Schema grep
novel_features.description: Find any form, field, or subform on your tenant by name fragment, instantly and offline.

novel_features.name: Schema snapshot diff
novel_features.description: Snapshot your tenant's schema and see exactly which forms and fields changed after an upgrade or customization.

novel_features.name: License probe
novel_features.description: Discover which forms are actually API-enabled on this tenant instead of finding out via 400 errors.

novel_features.name: Batch journal + resume
novel_features.description: Re-run only the failed operations from a partially-failed $batch — Priority batches have no rollback.

novel_features.name: Sync reconcile
novel_features.description: Verify your local mirror matches the live tenant using windowed probes — the API has no $count.

novel_features.name: Shortage (ATP)
novel_features.description: See which parts will run out given the open order book — open demand vs on-hand stock, optionally netting inbound POs.

novel_features.name: Customer 360
novel_features.description: One command for a customer's whole picture: invoiced totals, age buckets by invoice date, open orders, recent invoices.
